review_method: Verified all 606 source identities, English text provenance and per-image rights against pinned inputs.
Reviewed all original images on 13 contact sheets for suitability, checked source conflicts and inspected the six replacement images.
Decoded every final asset and verified exact bytes, dimensions and MIME.
Reviewed English fallback and retained historical Polish records.
limitations: This scope is catalogue suitability and provenance. Remaining historical taxonomic nomenclature is retained.
Care data remains attributed reference data and does not confer a published care profile.
The full release has not been deployed to Supabase or checked in the iOS integration.
